DESIGN

Sleek, versatile style

Every Jelly75 ships with a contrast-cut Esc key and spacebar that break up the deck at a glance. Pick Orange Meadow for a warmer, retro-leaning desk, or Volt Green for something louder — the soft white backlight underneath adjusts across four brightness levels either way.

2Colorways
4Backlight levels
CONNECTIVITY

One board, five devices

Pair it over Bluetooth, 2.4GHz, or plug in with USB-C — Jelly75 remembers up to five hosts and switches between them instantly, with dedicated keys for jumping between Windows and macOS layouts. Hold Fn+T to push polling up to 1000Hz wired or 500Hz wireless when input lag matters.

5Devices paired
2OS layouts
1000HzWired polling
500Hz2.4GHz polling
TYPING FEEL

Built on a gasket, not a tray

A full gasket-mount structure floats the plate on a cushion instead of screwing it straight to the case, so every keystroke lands softer and quieter. It's the same structure you can see straight through the smoky shell.

GasketMount structure
Uni-cushionVibration damping
PERSONALIZATION

Swap switches, not solder

Every socket on Jelly75 is hot-swappable, so switching from linear to tactile — or just trying something new — takes a switch puller and a few minutes, no soldering iron required.

5-pinHot-swap sockets
0Soldering required
DURABILITY

Made to outlast the trend

Switches are rated for 50 million keystrokes, and the anti-slip PC keycaps hold their texture and legends long after cheaper boards fade. Charge it over USB-C and it keeps going for weeks on a single charge.

50MClick lifespan
USB-CRechargeable
DESIGN PROCESS · CASE STUDY

Gaming gear.
Not office gear.

That's the gap ASUS had to close. Here's how data got us there.

01 / MARKET SIGNAL

80 / 15 / 5 is the category rule

Three JD sales cycles showed a consistent hierarchy: calm base, supporting contrast, then one deliberate point of energy.

80%primary tone
15%secondary accent
5%pop accent

FINDINGKeep the base neutral; make the accent carry the point of view.
02 / PRODUCT DIRECTION

Color belongs at the edges

The key field stays quiet. Navigation and edit zones become the visual signature.

pattern detailshidden textvisible gasketcable detailstatus light
DESIGN RULELet transparency and the gasket do the talking, not a full-shell color fill.
03 / THEME TEST

Three directions. One clear decision.

Harmony LagomSafe, but blends into the quiet-keyboard aisle.
Aggressive & BoldDistinct, but slips back into gaming-peripheral language.
Clear MinimalismUses the shell's transparency as its own color system.
04–05 / TAKEAWAY

Make the product feel finished — not just transparent.

The selected arched transparency zone keeps the gasket visible, while seven personas validate that the direction holds across different desks.

RESULT Clear, gasket-mounted, and unmistakably Jelly75.
